reviewSamples.author: Photo of JustPassingBy
reviewSamples.text:
Can’t Stay Away!

Well we were back again this morning to try out their breakfast menus and once again it was on point. The savory flavors and beautifully plated dishes along with the customer service goes above and beyond. We walked in the door and was immediately greeted by Chef Nick who we met yesterday during our fist time there. He was so happy to see us back again so soon.

It was definitely busier for the Sunday morning breakfast rush, but that didn’t take away from us getting a seat right away with the food and customer service way above par! This time we brought a friend and between us we ordered the Avocado Toast, Loaded Hash browns, Pure Indulgence and Country Fried Steak.

Every bite was filled extremely flavorful up until the last one that it’s difficult to put your fork down. Run…don’t walk and go experience the amazing food for yourself!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Isaac Kuhlman
reviewSamples.text:
This restaurant is excellent. All scratch made food. The chef is the owner, and everything was top notch in terms of taste and freshness.

To start we got the pork belly poutine. Though, I would say that without cheese curds it may not technically classify as poutine, it was insanely good.

Then I got the chili Verde pork smothered breakfast burrito. It was very tasty. Though, if I could offer one upgrade, I would probably ask to have it filled with the carnitas instead of the bacon and sausage next time. It was really good though.

Speaking of carnitas, my wife got the carnitas hash, and I had a bite, and that was really, really good. Had I not been stuffed from my food, I would have eaten hers as well. Ha ha

You won't leave hungry here, and you won't be disappointed. We will be back to try more of the menu.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Andrew Ross
reviewSamples.text: The food is fantastic. Chef Nick clearly takes pride in his menu, which is waay above standard diner fare, matching presentation with great taste and perfect portion size. Off the Vegas beaten path but well worth it. We had breakfast, and will return for lunch.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sam Larter
reviewSamples.text:
From the second you come through the door into the bright, clean interior you are in for an amazing experience. We were quickly greeted by our server Raheem.

Quickly seated, we struggled to decide what to get as everything on the menu sounded wonderful. We decided on the Ham-Brie-Apple Panini, the Blueberry Streusel French Toast, the chicken and waffles, and the California Turkey Hash. Everything was Delicious! The beautiful presentation was only exceeded by the scrumptious flavors. 5 stars across the board.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Roger Fadersaer
reviewSamples.text: We were told to come visit this place and it didn’t disappoint. I had the country fried steak and my girl had the Carnitas Hash. Both were delicious. For dessert we the tiramisu….yummy!! The server was very friendly and the chef came out to greet us and even delivered our food. It may be small and intimate but the food were amazing visually and tasty. I’d definitely come back and try other dishes.
